body.x: V-Space (CEO Baek Seung Won) participated in CES 2024 held in Las Vegas, USA from January 9th to 12th.

V-Space has accumulated independent research and development capabilities in urban air mobility (UAM) and related aircraft. They have collaborated with major aerospace companies, defense industry firms, AAM, and UAM companies and institutions, achieving diverse successes in delivering aircraft and fostering collaborations within the industry.

In particular, V-Space unveiled its self-developed Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) aircraft, ‘V-Speeder,’ last year. The model boasts outstanding performance, with a maximum takeoff weight of 300kg and a top speed of around 90km/h. It gained attention by conducting test flights in the airspace above urban areas in Korea for the first time. This achievement is unprecedented globally, excluding companies like China’s ‘Ehang’ and Germany’s ‘Volocopter.’

At CES this year, V-Space plans to exhibit and present the V-Speeder to explore opportunities in the global market. The V-Speeder complies with the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) standards for personal aircraft, incorporating the company’s years of experience and technology in producing UAM aircraft and developing transportation mobility.

The currently mass-produced V-Speeder is an improved model with a payload of 120kg and a maximum speed of 80km/h, offering a full flight time of 20 minutes. Compared to competitors, the superior specifications and performance are realized by applying a high-density, high-output battery propulsion system—V-Space plans to expand sales by leveraging these advantages and a relatively lower price.

A representative from V-Space explained, “The V-Speeder, with outstanding performance relative to its price, is a product with broad applicability. It is equipped with options suitable for various applications, such as logistics delivery systems and emergency disaster rescue aircraft, enhancing its attractiveness.” Additionally, the representative expressed ambitions to diversify the product portfolio through technological diversification and expand purchases globally, aiming to become a world-class air mobility specialist.
